meta.title: Bridge · One frame of a camera following a predicted pawn
meta.subtitle: Tick gate → correction + LTW-only graphical pose → Bridge sync → Cinemachine damping

views.label: Full vs partial tick
views.note: At ratio 1, partial ticks skip PredictedFixedStepSimulationSystemGroup entirely.

views.label: Correction + graphical
views.note: Rollback eases LocalTransform; SmoothRigidBodies writes LocalToWorld only.

views.label: Bridge then lens
views.note: Bridge copies LTW with no lerp; Cinemachine damping is last, not a netcode fix.

messages.label: IsPartialTick?
messages.note: Every ClientSimulation frame carries NetworkTime; the fixed-rate manager gates physics on it.

messages.label: step physics (full tick)
messages.note: ShouldGroupUpdate allows steps when !IsPartialTick, or when m_StepRatio > 1 even on partial.

messages.label: no step @ ratio 1 partial
messages.note: Default 1:1 ratio: PredictedFixedStepSimulationSystemGroup does not run on partial ticks — LocalTransform holds still.

messages.label: rollback + replay → LocalTransform
messages.note: On snapshot mispredict, NetCode rewinds and re-simulates; GhostPredictionSmoothingSystem then eases Position only.

messages.label: eased Position (if registered)
messages.note: DefaultTranslationSmoothingAction blends LocalTransform.Position; Bridge never softens this.

messages.label: write LocalToWorld only
messages.note: SmoothRigidBodiesGraphicalMotion rewrites LocalToWorld and deliberately leaves LocalTransform alone — safe under rollback.

messages.label: still runs on partial
messages.note: Graphical smoothing is the sub-tick presentation path; it is not gated by the fixed-rate manager.

messages.label: entity LTW → Tracking/LookAt bridges
messages.note: CinemachineTargetBridgeSyncSystem assigns LTW with no lerp; missing LTW skips the copy.

messages.label: LTW → managed Transform → CM*
messages.note: BridgeTransformSyncSystem then CinemachineSyncSystem push ECS pose into the managed vcam Follow/LookAt.

messages.label: Brain + damping → view
messages.note: Cinemachine damping is last and cannot un-step a target that still jumps each tick.

items: Correction + graphical + Bridge + Brain still run
